scenicChapters.title: Montenegro Durmitor Ring
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 71 km this is Montenegro Durmitor Ring, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.

places-studenica-monastery-durmitor-nati.story: On the way it passes Grčko groblje, Durmitor National Park and back through Grčko groblje. The highest point is about 1,550 m. It crosses from Serbia into Montenegro - carry ID and check vignette or toll rules. The line favours views over speed.
